# Connapse

> Connapse is a self-hosted knowledge platform. It indexes uploaded files and external sources (Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, GitHub, Confluence, Jira, filesystems, SFTP and custom source servers) into containers, and serves hybrid vector and keyword search over a Blazor web UI, a REST API at /api/v1 and an MCP server at /mcp. Built on .NET 10, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and MinIO.

Every page below is Markdown. API keys go in the `X-Api-Key` header; errors are RFC 9457 problem details whose `type` links into problems.md.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](get-started/quickstart.md): run Connapse with Docker Compose, upload a document and search it
- [Tutorial: connect Claude to Connapse](get-started/connect-an-agent.md): create an agent key, connect over MCP and build a container

- [Custom source setup](sources/custom-source-setup.md): connect your own system through a custom source server
